temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and says he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him, which makes Christian anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Jonathan confirms he was hiding something and reveals that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in trouble and had been reluctant to share something serious.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the truth about Jonathan's trouble and learn what he is hiding.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it, but he accepts support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and hiding details; Christian is worried and empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Jonathan accepts Christian's help and admits he needs support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs Christian's help; they can face the complicated trouble together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help and support Jonathan, offering resources and standing by him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure if the trouble is illegal; he may have gotten involved with the wrong people, but he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and needs support; the situation is complicated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian comes to believe Jonathan's trouble may involve criminal or wrong people, though Jonathan denies personal illegal acts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is likely entangled with criminal or wrong people, but may not be personally guilty.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is likely entangled with criminal or wrong people, though he claims innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — evidence indicates Jonathan is being framed rather than guilty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed by someone.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name and gather evidence to prove his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds out the culprit is someone both he and Jonathan know and trust; Jonathan reacts with disbelief and warns that the person is dangerous.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown culprit; Christian is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — the real culprit is identified as someone close to both of them and trusted, and is dangerous.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: A trusted person close to them is responsible for framing Jonathan; the betrayal is dangerous.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
